discover.mapping: host web tooling, when the Codex host mode exposes it

inspect.mapping: read-verified file access; deeper tool modes host-dependent

inspect.degraded_mode: Use read-verified paths only and record the inspection limit per EXP-03 when deeper tooling is unavailable.

consult.mapping: route through another host adapter or the outer session
consult.evidence: No web or professional-agent consult channel is verified in this adapter, and sub_agent itself is degraded; draw-style generation is not consultation (R0 F-3).
consult.degraded_mode: Record 判定=受限 per EXP-03 and degrade to local evidence; do not fabricate external consultation.

validate.mapping: verify_workflow.py / test execution from the repo shell
validate.evidence: validation.command is required and git hooks are repository-level (git_hooks native), but in-session command execution is host-mode dependent (runtime_capabilities.tool_calling degraded: local validation commands are required for product closure).
validate.degraded_mode: Run the validation commands from the repo shell outside the Codex session and record the results; do not claim in-session execution that did not happen.

exploration_channels.degraded_mode: When a channel is unavailable, record 判定=受限 in the exploration block (M10.2) per EXP-03; never mark offline knowledge as channel results.
